_comment: Exercises botl.c fldname_to_bl_indx() (2219-2253) and match_str2conditionbitmask() (3170-3206) through parse_status_hl1()/parse_status_hl2() and parse_condition(): each compares names with fuzzymatch(..., " -_", TRUE), which skips spaces, hyphens and underscores but not a tab or form feed. A field name wrapped in tabs is an unknown status field, and a condition name followed by a form feed is an unknown condition, where 'Hit_Points' (canonical name), 'Experience-Points' (fieldids_alias[] entry) and 'Food-Pois' (conditions[] text) match. The variation is a canonical name against an alias.
